Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 612 PM EST Wed Nov 4 2026

- Chance for drizzle and rain showers this evening. 

- Briefly drier to start Thursday before scattered shower return 
late Thursday-Friday.

- Temperatures return to normal values to end the week.

&&

.AVIATION...

Upper level trough of low pressure will now be in place over 
Southeast Michigan throughout the period. Surface cold front is 
expected to push through all of the area by the first hour after taf 
issuance with low level cold advection providing for saturation and 
MVFR ceilings. Deepening of the cold air with time in the lower 
troposphere will lift ceilings heights to VFR by the mid to late 
evening. Strong midlevel subsidence between 5.0 and 15.0 kft agl 
will then end widespread precipitation tonight. Wrap around moisture 
advection with daytime heating is expected to result in diurnal 
shower development Thursday afternoon.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* High for ceiling 5000 ft or less tonight and Thursday.
